highlights.excerpt:
We built Pando, a new Git backend for our monorepo, to handle more pushes and fetches without changing how our engineers and agents use Git.

Pando cut push latency by ~80% and now serves nearly a petabyte of Git data a day. We can grow Git capacity alongside agent usage.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们为 monorepo 自研了新的 Git 后端 Pando，工程师和智能体照常用 Git，推送/拉取更稳。

Pando 把推送延迟砍了约 80%，每天服务近 1 PB 的 Git 数据，容量能跟着智能体用量一起长。
highlights.name: OpenAI Developers
highlights.text_zh: OpenAI 为 monorepo 自研 Pando Git 后端，推送延迟降约 80%，日服近 PB。

highlights.excerpt:
Friday was my last day at Anthropic.

Two years ago, when Claude Code was a small internal tool, I asked it to build an RL env. I steered it for tens of hours but never manually wrote a line of code. It worked, I was hooked, and I joined the team.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
周五是我在 Anthropic 的最后一天。

两年前 Claude Code 还只是内部小工具时，我让它搭了一个 RL 环境——盯了几十小时，自己一行代码没写。跑通了，上瘾了，于是加入了团队。
highlights.name: cat
highlights.text_zh: Claude Code 核心贡献者 cat 离开 Anthropic：从内部小工具到行业标杆。

highlights.excerpt: There's a buzzy new paper about GPT-6 Astra being able to directly interpret model weights (prompts full of floating point numbers) - I tried it with Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop and found that, after 45+ minutes, that model could achieve the same thing

highlights.name: Simon Willison
highlights.text_zh: 热议「GPT-6 Astra 读权重」论文；他用本机 Qwen 3.8 27B 复现同类能力。

highlights.excerpt: Underrated life advice: Your best years don't have to be behind you. You can be in the best shape of your life at 50. Start the company at 60. Fall in love at 70. Reinvent yourself at 80. Change doesn’t have an expiration date. Your best years are yours to create. So just start.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 被低估的人生建议：你最好的年份不必已经过去。50 岁可以是身材巅峰，60 岁创业，70 岁恋爱，80 岁重塑自己。改变没有保质期。最好的年份由你创造——所以现在就开始。
highlights.name: Sahil Bloom
highlights.text_zh: 被低估的人生建议：最好的年份没有保质期，50/60/70 都能重新开始。
